title: Adaptive Self-Consistency: From Black-Box Sampling to Distribution-Valued Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2609.38931v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-consistency samples many reasoning trajectories and aggregates their final answers, treating the LLM as a black box that returns one answer per trajectory. Yet the final answer of each trajectory is sampled from a softmax vector that is available from the model's log-probabilities. We refer to this as the grey-box setting in which each trajectory reveals this answer distribution rather than a single draw from it. We formulate efficient inference in this setting as sequential mode identification with distribution-valued observations: sample trajectories one at a time and stop as soon as the LLM's modal answer is identified at a prescribed confidence level. We characterize the asymptotic stopping rate of mode identification with distribution-valued observations exactly and show that it is never worse than the black-box rate. We then propose the ASC-D algorithm, a betting stopping rule that attains this asymptotic stopping rate. On M

translated_title: 自适应自洽性：从黑盒采样到分布值反馈
translated_abstract: 自洽性方法通过采样多条推理轨迹并聚合其最终答案来工作，将大语言模型视为一个黑盒，即每条轨迹仅返回一个答案。然而，每条轨迹的最终答案实际上是从一个softmax向量中采样得到的，而该向量可以从模型的对数概率中获得。我们将此称为灰盒设置，在这种设置下，每条轨迹揭示的是完整的答案分布，而非从中抽取的单个样本。我们将该设置下的高效推理形式化为基于分布值观测的顺序众数识别问题：逐条采样轨迹，并在以规定置信度水平识别出大语言模型的众数答案后立即停止。我们精确刻画了基于分布值观测的众数识别的渐近停止率，并证明其从不劣于黑盒停止率。随后，我们提出了ASC-D算法，这是一种能够达到该渐近停止率的赌注式停止规则。在M……
tldr: 该论文提出利用大语言模型对数概率中的完整答案分布（灰盒信息）替代黑盒单样本答案，将高效推理建模为基于分布值观测的顺序众数识别问题，并提出赌注式停止算法ASC-D，其渐近停止率从不劣于黑盒方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Adaptive Self-Consistency (ASC-D), which leverages the full answer distribution from the LLM's log-probabilities (grey-box setting) instead of a single black-box sampled answer, formulates efficient inference as sequential mode identification with distribution-valued observations, and proves that its betting-based stopping rule achieves an asymptotic stopping rate never worse than the black-box rate.
